paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Difficulty distribution of the data entries. Most of the dataset entries are classified as Medium (51.8%) or Hard (25.7%). A smaller proportion falls into the Easy (11.2%), Very Hard (6.5%), and Very Easy (4.7%) categories.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels across the dataset, with each segment representing a different difficulty category and its corresponding proportion of the total entries. The largest segment, colored red, corresponds to Medium difficulty, accounting for 51.8% of the data (725,892 entries). The second-largest segment, in blue, represents Hard difficulty, making up 25.7% of the dataset (360,137 entries). The green segment indicates Easy difficulty, comprising 11.2% of the entries (157,053). The orange segment, labeled Very hard, represents 6.5% of the data (91,576 entries), while the smallest segment, in light purple, corresponds to Very easy difficulty, at 4.7% (65,332 entries). The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that matches each color to its respective difficulty level and numerical count, and percentage values are displayed directly on each slice, providing a clear visual breakdown of the dataset's difficulty distribution.
